Spectrum

  • CURIE: gmeow:Spectrum
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Spectrum
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/music

A first-class information object representing a partial list or recording-region spectrum. Spectra are the source material from which pitch collections may be derived by a solver (fnSpectrumToPitchCollection) — the canonical content of spectralism (Principle 12).

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:InformationObject, gufo:Object

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:Spectrum as a specialized kind of gmeow:InformationObject, gufo:Object. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:InformationObject
